description: Supplement to the archive filter: replace visually reviewed female mission-preview and picture-in-picture portraits with two existing male game characters. Whole video frames are reused; original per-language audio packets, frame count, timing and alpha settings are preserved. This does not replace live 3D character models or cinematic scenes.

evidence.basis: Visual comparison with locally decoded BIK frames, not a claim of gameplay testing

limitations: Both portrait slots in selected clips use the male donor, not just the female slot.
Original dialogue remains, including female voices; lip motion may not match it.
Full-screen cinematics and live 3D character substitution are not implemented here.
Only the explicit reviewed video scope is covered; no claim that every female depiction in the game has been found.
